تغاضيت (form VI)
# تَغَاضَيْتُ (taḡāḍaytu) /ta.ɣaː.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَغَاضَى (taḡāḍā)
# تَغَاضَيْتَ (taḡāḍayta) /ta.ɣaː.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَغَاضَى (taḡāḍā)
# تَغَاضَيْتِ (taḡāḍayti) /ta.ɣaː.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَغَاضَى (taḡāḍā)
